name: Ferguson Enterprises Inc.

listing.exchange: New York Stock Exchange (sole listing; London listing cancelled 2024)
listing.domicile: United States (Delaware) - re-domiciled from Jersey (Ferguson plc) via new US holding company, effective 1-Aug-2024

corporate_actions.event: Re-domicile: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. (Delaware) became parent of Ferguson plc (Jersey); LSE standard listing cancelled; NYSE only (not re-verified to the day in this run)
Fiscal year changed from 31 July to calendar year (2026 guidance is calendar-year basis; PitchBook series ends TTM 1Q2026 under old fiscal labels)
Closed FloWorks acquisition (industrial valves/flow control); share buyback temporarily paused

geography.fx_notes: Q3 2026: US $8.6bn of $9.0bn total sales (~96%); Canada remainder. UK business sold 2021. CAD only FX exposure.

kpis.name: Large capital projects
kpis.value: Mid-to-high single digit % of revenue; ~half data centres

lease.source_id: US GAAP filer since re-domicile; operating leases in opex; not extracted

acquisitions.notes: 11 acquisitions with ~$1.5bn annualised sales; $1.7bn spent in Q3 alone on 3 deals incl. FloWorks (closed 31-Aug-2026), Brax, Rogers Supply; Canyon Systems after quarter end

management.guidance_record: Good: 2026 sales guide raised from mid-single digit to ~7%

ownership.controlling_holders: None; widely held. Trian Fund Management (Nelson Peltz) was a significant shareholder historically - current stake not verified

guidance.value: 1-2x; return to lower end before resuming buybacks

A.rationale: Mixed: RMI provides durability but construction cycles dominate volume.

evidence: Largest US plumbing distributor with ~1,700 branches [S2]
B.rationale: Scale, density and multi-trade capability create a durable edge.

evidence: Op margin ~10% vs smaller plumbing peers (INFERENCE)
C.rationale: Scale shows in margins and share gain.

G.rationale: Disciplined; FloWorks is larger and needs proving.

evidence: Large capital projects mid-high single digit %, ~half DC => ~3-4% DC [S1]
Commodity price deflation/inflation passes with lag [S1]
Adjusted EBITDA vs GAAP modest gaps

ai.notes: ESTIMATE: large capital projects 'mid-to-high single digits' of revenue, roughly half data centres => ~3-4% (midpoint 3.5%). Semiconductor fabs also within large projects (not quantified). Indirect power-generation demand from DCs adds further unquantified exposure.

sector_specific.notes: construction_pct = new construction share (~1/3, FACT from CEO); total res+non-res incl. RMI is ~100% building-related. acquisition_growth_pct = Q3 2026 (FACT); 9M 1.5%. ai_dc_pct is ESTIMATE from management ranges.

gates.notes: G5: DC ~3-4% (<15%). G6: US re-domiciled, no pending transaction. Leverage 1.7x.

bull_points: Market outperformance: Q3 organic +7% with US non-res +15% and residential +6% in a weak market (S1)
Large, fragmented $400bn TAM with active bolt-on M&A and HVAC dual-trade build-out (S1)
bear_points: Single-country (US) and construction-cycle exposure; residential remains weak (S1)
FloWorks is a larger deal adding leverage and integration risk; buyback paused (S1)
thesis_breakers: Organic growth below US market (peer) growth for 4 consecutive quarters
Net debt/EBITDA above 2.5x without deleveraging path
Adjusted operating margin below 8.5% for a full year
